purpose: Improve touching-instance separation and enable direct AJI, PQ, DICE1/2, and Caicedo object-F1 comparison.
schedule: 20-epoch cosine decay to 1% of initial learning rate; no early stopping
augmentation: uniform rotations by multiples of 90 degrees and horizontal flip with probability 0.5
targets: BBBC039 red-channel graph colours are first converted to touching-aware instances; one-pixel inner contours are dilated by one pixel on both sides to form 0=background, 1=interior, and 2=boundary targets
loss: class-frequency-balanced cross entropy plus mean soft Dice over interior and boundary classes
selection: highest validation Caicedo average object F1; official test decoded once after selection
postprocessing: connected components of predicted interior, minimum size 16; boundary expansion reported as a declared secondary output
primary_endpoint: Caicedo average object F1 over IoU thresholds 0.50 to 0.90
